narrative: Taking Iceberg v3 with Polaris bi-directional writes to GA removes table-format lock-in and pushes the contest up to the governance-and-ontology layer that mediates what agents may touch, the structural force the prediction names. Cortex Sense over Horizon Context plus live BlackRock and Sanofi agents are the platform-native agent-context surface bundled rather than bolted on.
remaining_gap: The per-tool-call MCP-identity-gateway leg (the Natoma capability) got no GA artifact; the surface shown is ontology and governance, not identity-and-access at the MCP tool-call level.
